newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Enviroserv buys Waste-Tech for 189 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Enviroserv buys Waste-Tech for 189 mln rand.

text.p: Enviroserv Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had bought 100 percent of Waste-Tech from Fraser Alexander and its management in a deal worth 189 million rand.

The acquisition was effective January 1 1997 and would be settled by the issue of 45.1 million Enviroserv shares, representing 45 percent of the enlarged Enviroserv's issued share capital, the company said in a statement.

"The merger with Waste-Tech will provide critical mass in all our operations and the integration of the businesses will yield considerable operating efficiencies," EnviroServ chairman Alistair McLean said.

He said the group was well positioned to offer clients a total waste management service throughout South Africa as Waste-Tech and Enviorserv were the leading waste management companies in the country.
They both operate in the domestic, industrial and medical waste sectors and operate both collection and disposal operations.
Rufus Maruma, charmain of Waste-Tech, will be the executive chairman of the merged company.
